dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q78l](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q78l) Magnitude 5.9 earthquake at 17.877 depth occurred on Apr 19 2025 47km S of Palimbang. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 5.7955 longitude 124.1064. It impacted 74807 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
